description: Only for checking on a match or feed rebuild that is already running (after upload_cv, update_targeting or refresh_matches); to find or show jobs use list_matching_jobs. Live status of the latest match run (scanned, inserted, elapsed), the feed counts it produced, and `feed_build`: where the feed is in its build (queued, building, ready, failed). Poll after upload_cv, update_targeting or refresh_matches; the feed is final only when feed_build.feed_state.state is `ready`.
name: get_match_status
title: Is a match run in progress
